text.description_html:
Bommer LB4373-400, 4" x 4" x 5/8" Radius Heritage One Single Acting Spring Hinge

Packaged completed with a Pair (2) Single Action Spring Door Hinges, Tension Adjusting Tool, Locking Pins plus machine screws. Utilizes ANSI a template screw hole pattern on one leaf and a zig zag pattern on the other leaf. Fo use with wood or metal doors.

Bommer spring hinges are UL Listed for fire door applications, certified Grade 1 (highest grade) for 1 million cycles and made in the USA. Pivot point aligns with residential butt hinges gage .085 to .109

The included Tension Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pins hold the Spring in tension after it is set. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes).

Specifications for Bommer LB4373-400 Spring Hinge

  • Hinge Material: Durable Steel
  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: 5/8" Radius
  • Gauge of Metal: .096 (standard)
  • Number of Holes: 8
  • Template Hole Pattern and Zig Zag Pattern
  • Machine Screws: #10-24 x 1/2"
  • Machine Screws: #10-24 x 1/2" with number 10 head.
  • Adjustable Spring Torque
  • Non-Handed
  • UL Listed for fire door applications.
  • BHMA Certified Grade 1 for 1 million cycles.
  • Bommer LB4373-400 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold as a pair (2 Hinges).
